question: Allah Jilai Bai, a singer from Rajasthan is famous for which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Folk Songs__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Allah Jilai Bai was a **folk singer** from **Bikaner**, **Rajasthan**. 
 
• She was in Durbar of **Maharaja Ganga Singh**.
 
• She was well versed in** Maand, Thumri, Khayal and Dadra**.
 
• In** 1982**, the Indian Government awarded her the **Padma Shri** in** Arts field**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
